title: Pension or gratuity status
subject: Status of my pension case
body:
Please provide the following information about my pension case (PPO number [PPO number], retired on [retirement date]):
1. The current status of my pension file and the section where it is pending.
2. The dates on which the file moved between sections since [date].
3. Copies of the file notings on my case.

title: Copy of an exam answer sheet
subject: Certified copy of my answer sheet
body: Please provide a certified copy of my evaluated answer sheet for the [exam name] examination held on [exam date], roll number [roll number], paper [paper or subject], including the marks awarded for each question.

title: File notings on my application
subject: File notings on my application
body:
I submitted an application for [what you applied for] on [date] (reference number [reference number]). Please provide:
1. Copies of all file notings and correspondence on it.
2. The names and designations of the officers who handled it.
3. The reason for the delay, if a decision is pending.

title: Tender or contract records
subject: Records of tender [tender number]
body:
Please provide copies of the following records for tender number [tender number] for [work description]:
1. The notice inviting tenders and bid evaluation sheet.
2. The work order issued and the contract value.
3. Payments released to the contractor to date.

title: Action taken on my complaint
subject: Action taken on my complaint
body:
I submitted a complaint on [date] about [subject of complaint] (reference number [reference number]). Please provide:
1. The action taken on my complaint, with dates.
2. Copies of any inquiry report or reply prepared.
3. The name of the officer currently responsible.
